name: Ancient murrelet
desc: A burrow-nesting seabird; about half the world population breeds on Haida Gwaii. Eats small fish and crustaceans.
about: The ancient murrelet is a bird in the auk family. The English term "murrelet" is a diminutive of "murre", a word of uncertain origins, but which may imitate the call of the common guillemot.
